kjv: I must work the works of him that sent me
mine: We must work the works of him who sent me
note: TR "eme" against "hemas" (P66, P75, Sinaiticus*, B, D); the plural draws the disciples into the work.

kjv: Dost thou believe on the Son of God?
mine: Do you believe in the Son of Man?
note: TR "theou" against "anthropou" in P66, P75, Sinaiticus, B, D, W; the more familiar confessional title replaced John's.
